title: HR Administrator
description:
People & Operations Assistant

Caversham, Reading
£28,000 - £32,000 per annum
Full-time Office-based (5 days per week)

Reed HR are delighted to be partnering with a growing and people-focused organisation in Caversham to recruit a People & Operations Assistant.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive HR professional looking to develop their career within a busy and supportive People team. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the employee lifecycle, ensuring HR administration is delivered accurately, efficiently and confidentially.

The Role

Reporting to the People & Operations Manager, you will provide comprehensive administrative support across all areas of HR and People Operations. This varied position offers exposure to recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, payroll administration, training coordination and HR projects.

Key responsibilities include:
- Maintaining employee records and HR systems, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.
- Supporting recruitment activities, onboarding and offboarding processes.
- Preparing HR documentation including contracts, letters and employee correspondence.
- Assisting with payroll administration and monthly payroll inputs.
- Monitoring and maintaining holiday and sickness absence records.
- Coordinating training activities and compliance requirements.
- Responding to employee and manager queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Supporting the review and maintenance of company policies and procedures.
- Assisting with employee relations processes and case administration.
- Producing HR reports and management information as required.
- Supporting wider People projects and initiatives across the business.

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience within an HR Administration, HR Assistant or People Coordinator role.
- Good knowledge of HR practices and employment legislation.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- A professional and confidential approach to handling sensitive information.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong IT skills including Microsoft Office applications.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- A proactive approach with strong problem-solving skills.
- Payroll administration experience would be advantageous.
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or working towards this would be desirable but is not essential.

If you're an enthusiastic HR professional looking for your next challenge and keen to build your experience across the full employee lifecycle, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Robert Half are delighted to be partnering with a small, ambitious and friendly business based in Oxford. They are looking for an Accounts Assistant to take ownership of an important part of the financial operation.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with finance experience who enjoys variety, likes working with people as well as numbers, and wants to play a genuinely meaningful role within a growing, close-knit business.

The Role

Reporting into the finance team, you will play a key role in ensuring customer accounts are accurately maintained and payments are received and allocated promptly. You'll be working with customers from around the world across multiple currencies, and the role goes well beyond routine accounts receivable. You'll also liaise with sales and marketing colleagues, resolve customer queries, produce reports, and get involved in wider business projects.

Key responsibilities include:
- Allocating customer payments accurately against invoices and reconciling bank accounts
- Preparing and importing bank statements into Xero
- Proactively chasing outstanding debts by phone and email, maintaining accurate records of collection activity
- Managing the accounts receivable inbox and resolving customer queries promptly and professionally
- Producing and reviewing the monthly Aged Debtors Report
- Maintaining and updating debt-tracking spreadsheets and reports
- Supporting the wider finance function with ad hoc projects and administration

About You
- Previous experience in an accounts receivable, credit control or accounts assistant role
- Confident working with multiple currencies and reconciling accounts
- Strong communication skills, with the confidence to proactively chase payments
- Organised, accurate and comfortable managing a varied workload
- Experience with Xero (or similar accounting software) is desirable but not essential

What's on Offer
- Salary of up to £32,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working - 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
- Discretionary annual bonus
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, rising with service (up to 30 days)
- Early finish on Fridays
- Company pension scheme
- Quarterly team socials and Christmas party
- Free on-site parking
- The chance to join a small, fun team with genuine international reach

Apply Now

If you're looking for a varied finance role within a supportive, sociable team where you can make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact Robert Half's Oxford office for a confidential conversation.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training. If you wish to apply, please read our Privacy Notice describing how we may process, disclose and store your personal data:

title: Commercial Property Secretary
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Macildowie are working with this client based in Oxford to recruit an experienced Legal Secretary to join their Commercial Property team.

Legal Secretary - Commercial Property

Location: Oxford
Salary: £30000
Contract: Permanent
Working Arrangement: Hybrid and Flexible

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established professional services organisation, providing high-quality secretarial and administrative support to a busy team of property specialists.

You'll be working closely with fee earners, helping to ensure commercial property matters progress smoothly and clients receive a professional and responsive service. It's a varied position where organisation, accuracy and the ability to juggle competing priorities will be key.

What will you be doing?

You'll provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support, including:
- Creating, formatting and amending legal documents and correspondence
- Producing accurate documentation from digital dictation
- Preparing leases, reports and other property-related documents
- Managing diaries, meetings and day-to-day administration for fee earners
- Opening, maintaining and closing client and matter files
- Liaising professionally with clients, agents, solicitors and other external parties
- Supporting commercial property transactions with searches and documentation
- Assisting with Land Registry and Companies House documentation
- Supporting Stamp Duty Land Tax returns, completion paperwork and post-completion administration
- Assisting fee earners with time recording, billing and routine accounting queries
- Scanning, printing and preparing documentation for signature

What are we looking for?

You'll be highly organised, accurate and comfortable working in a fast-paced professional environment.

Previous legal secretarial experience would be highly desirable, with experience supporting Commercial Property or Real Estate teams particularly advantageous.

You'll also need:
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills
- Strong written and verbal communication
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good IT literacy and confidence learning new systems
- Experience working with document and/or case management systems
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- A professional and client-focused approach

If you're an experienced Legal Secretary looking for your next opportunity in Oxford, we'd be keen to hear from you.

Please apply with your latest CV for further information.

Macildowie is a specialist recruitment consultancy with a rich history of enhancing the careers of professionals across the Midlands and Northern Home Counties. We have an unrivalled understanding of the local market and are dedicated to helping you achieve your career aspirations.

title: Administration Assistant
company: Herefordshire and Worcestershire Health and Care NHS Trust

description: Tenbury Hospital is a forward-thinking community hospital supporting our local population and the acute services from Worcester and Hereford. We provide inpatient services, a minor injury unit and an outpatient department. We are looking for an enthusiastic, compassionate team player to work within the Administration Team. The Administration Team carry out a variety of duties, covering reception, ward administration including admitting and discharging patients, scanning, booking transport and appointments, managing patient records and a variety of general administration tasks, supporting the clinical staff and patients. Each day will be different, and the role will involve working across all administrative functions within the team. As you will be working directly with our patients and relatives you will be required to adhere to confidentiality and data protection policies at all times. This post is for 22.5 hrs per week. Applicants must read the attached guidance notes before submitting your application for full understanding of Trust requirements. You will need to be a team player, with a flexible "can do" approach together with the ability to prioritise your own workload. We will provide the successful candidate with appropriate training in the necessary processes and Trust IT systems and ongoing support in their use. The successful candidate will have excellent interpersonal, administrative, and organisational skills and be able to demonstrate initiative. The role will involve a variety of administrative tasks as set out in the job description. You will need to be able to work as part of a team and be efficient and organised with your own workload. For full details of the duties and criteria for the role please refer to the job description and person specification attached.

title: Receptionist
description: The Key Medical Practice are looking for multiple Receptionists, candidates that are looking for both full and part time will be considered. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis as they are received. This vacancy will remain open until filled, so early applications are encouraged. Position Purpose To provide a welcoming, safe and efficient first point of contact for patients accessing clinical services. The Clinical Receptionist ensures smooth patient flow, accurate management of clinical information, and timely support to clinicians. This role contributes directly to patient experience, service quality, and the safe operation of the clinical environment. Job Responsibilities Patient Reception & Front-of-House Care Greets patients with professionalism, empathy and reassurance, recognising that many may be anxious, unwell or vulnerable. Provides clear information about check-in, waiting times, and processes Supports patients with accessibility needs (mobility, sensory needs, language barriers) and escalates concerns appropriately. Manages busy waiting areas calmly, maintaining a safe and respectful atmosphere Appointment & Clinical Workflow Coordination Books, amends and coordinates appointments following clinical priority protocols (training provided). Identifies urgent or same-day clinical requests and escalates according to triage guidelines. Helps maintain efficient clinical sessions by ensuring clinicians schedules run smoothly Supports handling of repeat prescription requests and directs clinical queries to appropriate staff. Confidentiality, Data Protection & Accurate Record-Keeping Handles confidential health information (e.g., medical notes, results, patient details) in line with GDPR and clinical governance standards. Updates patient records accurately and promptly using clinical systems (full training provided) Ensures correct patient identity verification to maintain patient safety. Processes clinical documents such as referrals, hospital letters, discharge summaries and results for action. Telephone & Digital Communication Handling Answers calls calmly and professionally, often under pressure and high call volumes. Uses clinical judgement boundaries (training given) to recognise urgent calls and escalate appropriately. Provides patients with accurate information about services, results handling, repeat prescriptions, and clinical pathways. Supports digital care navigation (e-consults, SMS messaging systems, online triage tools). Safety, Compliance & Clinical Environment Support Maintains a safe and clean reception and waiting area in line with infection control guidance. Follows safeguarding procedures and escalates concerns immediately. Supports emergency protocols, including contacting clinical staff if a patient deteriorates in the waiting room. Adheres to confidentiality, incident reporting and clinical governance procedures. Teamwork & Integrated Clinical Support Works collaboratively with clinicians, nurses, practice managers and administrative teams. Supports colleagues during busy clinics or staff shortages. Contributes to a positive, respectful, values-based team culture. Participates in mandatory training and role-specific development.
